scientific_question: Does matched supervision on student-visited failure/recovery states improve fresh-task closed-loop success more than matched successful-demonstration supervision?
hypothesis: H1.11 and H1.13 fit successful targets without selective transfer because autonomous failures visit states absent from the successful-state distribution. Training on recovery actions from student-visited deviations should improve closed-loop recovery if source-state distribution is the bottleneck.
independent_variable: training source-state distribution only: successful demonstration states versus student-visited failure/recovery states

training_panel.task_role: train-only engineering-qualification rollouts; disjoint from the held-out evaluation tasks below and from H1.10 positive/negative source tasks
training_panel.student_trace_rule: retain parser-valid states before a repeated-next, repeated-action, or backtrack action; cap at four candidates per episode; no fallback state enters labels
training_panel.teacher_boundary: teacher/oracle may label train-only student states and generate train-only successful demonstrations; never assists evaluation

evaluation_panel.task_role: held-out evaluation only; no outcome or trace may flow back into training labels

arms_contract.BASE: frozen base model with no new adapter
arms_contract.SUCCESS-STATE-CONTROL: successful-demonstration action targets from matched teacher states
arms_contract.STUDENT-RECOVERY: teacher/oracle action targets from matched student-visited failure, deviation, or non-progress states

forbidden: counting teacher-assisted success as Qwen/OpenEvo success

frozen_variables.training_budget: rank 4 q_proj/v_proj; one epoch; four optimizer steps; bfloat16; equal record/token budget after preregistered normalization
frozen_variables.evaluation: frozen Qwen2.5 artifact alone; no teacher, memory, prompt rescue, or action post-processing

required: training task IDs disjoint from evaluation task IDs
evaluation seeds disjoint from acquisition seeds
contamination_check.fail_closed: any identity, task, seed, or teacher-boundary mismatch invalidates the affected cell and does not enter the scientific denominator

resource_budget.cell_design: 3 arms x 2 held-out partitions = 6 cells; 16 evaluation attempts/cell; one independent UUID-bound cell per authorized GPU
resource_budget.expected_gpu_hours: bounded to the existing four-step training plus 96 evaluation attempts; record actual usage
resource_budget.current_gate: do not launch until GPUs are genuinely idle and authorized; current GPUs 1-7 are not genuinely idle

stop_rule: one bounded panel only; do not sweep rank/LR/epoch or reword recovery prompts after a negative result

branch_rule.positive: STUDENT-RECOVERY selectively beats BASE and SUCCESS-STATE across preregistered partitions/task identities: run independent new-task/new-seed confirmation; Q3 remains closed until confirmation
branch_rule.task_specific: retain heterogeneity evidence; no Q3 opening or generalization claim
branch_rule.negative: stop parametric micro-variants and run the matched BASE vs TEXT-MEMORY vs PARAMETRIC carrier diagnostic
branch_rule.invalid: repair only the failed runtime/provenance contract without changing the frozen scientific question

upstream_audit.decision: do not upgrade the pinned runtime for H1.14; use upstream increment/provenance/carrier-isolation principles only

prior_diagnostic.interpretation: 28/32 BASE/SUCCESS pairs diverged early; this motivates student-state recovery but is not H1.14 evidence

resource_preparation_result.next: Use the frozen recovery corpus only under the separately registered H1.15 carrier diagnostic.

train_oracle_reachability_audit.method: exact goal query, deterministic target-ASIN click, exact goal-option clicks, buy-now when available; no model inference
train_oracle_reachability_audit.scientific_role: feasibility evidence only; not an H1.14 closed-loop result or denominator change

claim_boundary: Student-state recovery diagnosis only; no Q3 opening, benchmark/generalization claim, H2, D0, retention/transfer claim, or SEED comparison before independent confirmation.
